notes: The head of the כָּהַן unit is taken on minister; the priest's office reading under rule 44 is named in the note.

The first marker takes the 'upon' by which the recast English verb reaches Aaron (rule 16); the second marker, on the garments, is unrepresented. Rule 44's supplied-preposition clause does not compete, since a marker is present.
The waw of וְכִהֵן takes the subordinator that under rules 14 and 55, a conjunction being present in the clause.
